property_summary: For any admissible timestamp ts, after a valid 10-ether fallback call at ts, a second valid 10-ether call at the same timestamp in a later block must revert (C stores block.timestamp as the lock, which equals ts); the mutant stores block.number (< ts) as the lock, so the second call succeeds for some input.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the block number instead of the timestamp is stored.
